verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a CRM, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows Attio offers a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product. The docs describe only Attio's hosted workspaces, REST API, App SDK and MCP integrations, and they state that even custom apps 'run inside Attio's infrastructure'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
